lastResponse.text: I hear you. If he comes inside and you’re not safe, call nine one one now when you can do it safely. If speaking is risky, stay quiet, move to the safest exit or public spot you can, and keep this call minimal. I can connect you to a live two one one person right now, and you can say only a few words. You are not alone, and this is not your fault.
